description: This Java class 'CashBasedAccountingProcessorForShares' implements accounting processing for share transactions, including creating journal entries for purchase, redemption, and charge payments within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: CashBasedAccountingProcessorForShares
classes.description: A component class implementing accounting processing for share transactions, handling journal entries for purchase, redemption, and charges.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForShares
methods.description: Creates journal entries for each share transaction, handling purchase, redemption, and charge payment types.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForRedeem
methods.description: Creates journal entries for redeeming shares, considering charge amounts and transaction status.

methods.name: createJournalEntriesForPurchase
methods.description: Creates journal entries for purchasing shares, considering transaction status and charge amounts.
